notes: The chapter analysed one construction two ways: a preposition before a construct noun rendered by a single English preposition. LIPHNE -> before (13.22) and AL ODOT -> because of (13.24) share one unit under rule 30, and AL PI (13.3) and AL YAD (13.29) split only because each morpheme holds English of its own. BETOKHAH -> 'in it' is the first shape, not the second: the ASV writes one preposition for the pair, so the BE and TAVEKH share one unit headed on the construct noun, and the suffix keeps its own 'it'. Nothing else in the verse changes.
